author: david.le
_comment: David: v1 was a static 3-row UBO table (only three holders can each exceed 25%) with 25 hard-coded in the validation and one look-through row per entity. Counsel's Revision 2 needs 10% or more and up to 4 tiers for High-Risk Exposure investors and Multi-Tier Holding Structures. Threshold, scope and depth are now parameters, the table is a recursive repeater, and migrate.v1_to_v2 upgrades live drafts in place. Section refs follow counsel's Revision 2 numbering, also used in luxembourg_cssf_10pct_aml_compliance_guide.pdf. To reuse for another fund: change parameters (with an audit entry), never the field logic.

ubo_threshold_pct._comment: Standard: more than 25% (AML Law Art. 1(7) indicator; Section 5.2(a)). Resolved per investor. Never write 25 or 10 into an expr; read params.ubo_threshold_pct.

ubo_threshold_inclusive._comment: 25% is exclusive ('more than'); counsel's 10% is inclusive ('10% or more'). The comparator travels with the number.

strict_lookthrough_applies_to._comment: The toggle. ['NONE'] = 25% for everyone; ['ALL_INVESTORS'] = 10% for everyone. A new fund flips this with an audit entry instead of rebuilding the form.

max_depth._comment: Tier 1 = direct holders of the Investor. A legal person still over threshold at Tier 4 escalates (5.3(d)); there is no Tier 5 row.

high_risk_list_source._comment: countries[] is materialised from these lists at snapshotDate; every threshold resolution logs the snapshotDate it used.

audit.approvedBy: Northlake compliance officer, relayed by elena.rostova
Northlake compliance officer, relayed by elena.rostova

fields.expr: investor.domicile in params.high_risk_list_source.countries || investor.funding_account_country in params.high_risk_list_source.countries
fields._comment: Section 3.2(a) domiciled / 3.2(b) routing capital. Recomputed on every save: changing the remitting bank account can flip it.
Section 3.3(a) declared in the risk questionnaire / 3.3(b) a legal person disclosed at Tier 2 or below. The declaration catches chains hidden below the 25% cut, where Tier 2 never opens.

fields.label: Beneficial ownership: holders of the Investor (Section 5.3(a), Tier 1)

itemFields._comment: Residence for natural persons, incorporation for entities.
Section 5.2(b): control by other means, disclosed at any %.
Section 4; true routes the investor to the enhanced tier.
Section 5.3(c); parent.effective_pct is 100 at the Investor.

validation.message: Holdings disclosed for one entity cannot exceed 100%.
Tier 4 is the last tier (Section 5.3(d)): upload a certified structure chart instead.
This entity meets the applicable threshold: disclose its own holders (Section 5.2(c), Section 5.3(b)).

rules._comment: The ONLY place the threshold switches. Not in scope -> defaults (25, exclusive). Re-run on every save, so a new remitting account or a Tier 2 legal person re-scopes the draft.
Section 5.3(d). Do not add a Tier 5 to make the error go away.

rules.then: map ubo_table.rows -> ubo.owners (depth 1) and lookthrough rows -> children (depth 2); keep every entered value; set draft.schemaVersion = '2.0.0'; re-run ubo.resolve_threshold; if new required items: status = 'NEEDS_INFO' and notify the investor listing only those items; else status unchanged
rules._comment: Section 7.2(a). Never edit a threshold in place on a published version: bump the version and migrate. SIGNED drafts are out of scope (7.2(b)). A v1 look-through row typed NATURAL_PERSON but named like an entity is flagged for re-confirmation, not auto-converted. Run 2025-09-30: 31 drafts, 0 values lost, 7 NEEDS_INFO, 24 unchanged.
